description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Southern Development - The additional sea area is placed to Port Limits of the Port of Hambanthota
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made by the Minister under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act, No. 51 of 1979. It specifically modifies port limits and jurisdiction areas through a statutory instrument, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the core content is regulatory in nature concerning maritime jurisdiction boundaries.
